sanskrit_verse:
गीतज्ञो यदि योगेन नाप्नोति परमं पदम् ।
रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते ॥
transliteration: gītajño yadi yogena nāpnoti paramaṃ padam | rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has mastered the Gita but fails to attain the Supreme State through Yoga becomes a follower of Rudra and rejoices with him.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from realized consciousness, not unenlightened action
Causation originates in spiritual capacity, not external performance
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with ontological truth
Restoration logic operates through sequential embodiment and association
Consciousness alignment determines post-life relational continuity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent has Gita mastery AND lacks Yoga-realization THEN assign Rudric association UNTIL further realization
IF consciousness state is unliberated THEN bind to higher-capacity entity FOR experiential completion
IF spiritual threshold not crossed THEN enforce associative learning WITH corresponding divine form
IF no punitive intent THEN redirect karmic flow INTO restorative spiritual ecosystems
supreme_court_application: In cases involving post-death spiritual status or metaphysical rights, the court shall recognize that incomplete realization results in continued association with corresponding divine entities for experiential completion rather than punitive assignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramana-based observation, it is established that unfulfilled spiritual capacity leads to anupurva causal sequence where the being aligns with Rudra for further unfoldment. This reflects proportional responsibility rooted in self-determined capacity, not imposed consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate associative resonance protocol linking individual consciousness with Rudric field
Activate experiential mirroring mechanism for unexpressed yogic potential
Establish completion loop between incomplete seeker and divine guide
Realign subtle body channels to receive transformative Rudric energies
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through consciousness-aligned succession. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
